name: literature-review
description: Multi-engine academic literature search and review writing assistant supporting Semantic Scholar, OpenAlex, Crossref, and PubMed databases.

displayDescription.en: Multi-engine academic literature search and review writing assistant. Searches Semantic Scholar, OpenAlex, Crossref, and PubMed for papers, abstracts, and citations, then helps draft structured review sections with proper deduplication.
displayDescription.zh: 多引擎学术文献检索与综述写作专家。支持四大数据库搜索论文，提取DOI自动去重，辅助撰写文献综述。

defaultInitPrompt.en: What topic are you researching? I can search Semantic Scholar, OpenAlex, Crossref, and PubMed to find papers and help draft your literature review.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 您想研究什么课题？我可以搜索Semantic Scholar、OpenAlex、Crossref、PubMed四大数据库，帮您查找论文并撰写文献综述。

quickPrompts.en: What topic are you researching? I can search Semantic Scholar, OpenAlex, Crossref, and PubMed to find papers and help draft your literature review.
quickPrompts.zh: 您想研究什么课题？我可以搜索Semantic Scholar、OpenAlex、Crossref、PubMed四大数据库，帮您查找论文并撰写文献综述。

quickPrompts.en: Search for recent papers on the gut-brain axis and summarize key findings.
quickPrompts.zh: 搜索关于肠脑轴的最新论文，并总结关键发现。

quickPrompts.en: Get full details for a specific DOI and help me cite it properly.
quickPrompts.zh: 查询某篇DOI论文的详细信息，并帮我正确引用。
